reviewNote: DRAFT, unreviewed by any Hebrew teacher. Pronunciation shown is Israeli only. Not user-tested; the 10-minute figure is a design budget, not a measured result.
goal: Read 3 real Hebrew words aloud after 5 letters and 2 vowels, within a 10-minute budget.

letters.sound: v (or part of the vowel o/u)
h at the start, silent at the end of a word

vowels.note: Kamatz: the T-shaped sign under the letter.
Vav with a dot above it reads as the vowel oh; the vav is not a v here.

honestyNote: Only one of the three words (shalom) is in the Priestly Blessing. The blessing's other words need letters (yod, bet, resh, kaf, final kaf, nun, and so on) and vowels (tzere, segol, shva) outside the 5 letters and 2 vowels taught here. Extending to the full verse is a later step.

steps.title: Hebrew reads right to left
